tasks.description: CONFIRM ALL EMERGENCY STOP BUTTONS ARE CLEARLY ACCESSIBLE AND OPERATIONAL BEFORE STARTING SHIFT — TEST EACH E-STOP AND VERIFY RESET
PERFORM FULL VISUAL INSPECTION OF MACHINE EXTERIOR FOR SIGNS OF FLUID LEAKS, UNUSUAL NOISE, VIBRATION OR VISIBLE DAMAGE TO GUARDS OR ENCLOSURES
CHECK PREFORM INFEED CONVEYOR AND HOPPER FOR JAMS, BLOCKAGES OR FOREIGN OBJECTS — CLEAR ANY OBSTRUCTION USING APPROVED TOOLS ONLY
CHECK BOTTLE DISCHARGE CONVEYOR FOR BLOCKAGES, FALLEN BOTTLES OR DEFORMED BOTTLES OBSTRUCTING PRODUCT FLOW — REMOVE REJECTS FROM LINE
VERIFY ALL GUARD DOORS ARE SECURELY CLOSED AND SAFETY INTERLOCKS ARE ACTIVE DURING PRODUCTION — REPORT ANY OPEN GUARD OR DEFEATED INTERLOCK IMMEDIATELY
MONITOR HIGH-PRESSURE BLOW AIR SUPPLY PRESSURE GAUGE ON HMI PANEL — VERIFY PRESSURE IS WITHIN OPERATIONAL RANGE (38–40 BAR) — LOG ANY DEVIATION
CHECK HEATING OVEN TEMPERATURE READINGS FOR ALL HEATING ZONES ON HMI PANEL — VERIFY SETPOINTS ARE ACHIEVED AND NO ZONE ALARMS ARE ACTIVE
LOG CURRENT MACHINE HOUR COUNTER READING IN SHIFT MAINTENANCE LOG — RECORD ANY ALARMS, ABNORMALITIES OR NEAR-MISSES OBSERVED DURING THIS INSPECTION
[PART A — MACHINE RUNNING] CHECK AIR MANIFOLD DISTRIBUTION BLOCK FOR LEAKS, CRACKS OR LOOSE FITTINGS — MACHINE MUST REMAIN AT PRODUCTION SPEED DURING THIS CHECK
[PART A — MACHINE RUNNING] CHECK ALL HIGH-PRESSURE AIR HOSES CONNECTED TO BLOWING STATIONS FOR SIGNS OF RUBBING, CHAFING OR SURFACE CRACKING — REPLACE DAMAGED HOSES IMMEDIATELY
[PART A — MACHINE RUNNING] VERIFY AIR MANIFOLD PRESSURE READINGS AT EACH BLOWING STATION VIA HMI — RECORD ANY STATION DEVIATING MORE THAN Â±0.5 BAR FROM SETPOINT
[PART B — MACHINE STOPPED] INITIATE CONTROLLED STOP — PRESS E-STOP — ISOLATE MACHINE USING MAIN ISOLATOR — APPLY LOCKOUT/TAGOUT TO ALL ENERGY SOURCES — VERIFY ZERO ENERGY STATE
[PART B — MACHINE STOPPED] INSPECT MAIN TOOTHED DRIVE BELT FOR WEAR, FRAYING, CRACKING OR LOSS OF TENSION — REPLACE BELT IF ANY DEFECT IS VISIBLE — DO NOT OPERATE WITH DAMAGED BELT
[PART B — MACHINE STOPPED] APPLY SPECIFIED KRONES GREASE TO ALL LUBRICATION NIPPLES ON BLOWING STATIONS 1–12 PER LUBRICATION CHART — RECORD GREASE TYPE AND QUANTITY IN LUBE LOG
[PART B — MACHINE STOPPED] CHECK ALL 12 BLOWING STATION MOULD CLAMPING MECHANISMS FOR SECURE ENGAGEMENT AND CORRECT ALIGNMENT — REPORT ANY PLAY OR MISALIGNMENT TO MAINTENANCE ENGINEER
[PART B — MACHINE STOPPED] INSPECT STARWHEEL INFEED AND OUTFEED BEARINGS FOR PLAY, WEAR OR CONTAMINATION — MANUALLY ROTATE AND FEEL FOR ROUGHNESS OR BINDING
[PART B — MACHINE STOPPED] LUBRICATE STARWHEEL INFEED AND OUTFEED BEARINGS WITH SPECIFIED FOOD-GRADE GREASE — USE CORRECT GRADE ONLY — DO NOT MIX GREASE TYPES
[PART B — MACHINE STOPPED] CHECK STRETCHING ROD ASSEMBLIES ON ALL BLOWING STATIONS FOR CORRECT STROKE LENGTH AND ABSENCE OF LATERAL PLAY — ADJUST IF OUT OF SPECIFICATION
[PART B — MACHINE STOPPED] INSPECT ALL PNEUMATIC FITTINGS AND QUICK-CONNECT COUPLINGS THROUGHOUT THE MACHINE FOR SIGNS OF LEAKAGE OR WEAR — REPLACE WORN FITTINGS
[PART B — MACHINE STOPPED] COMPLETE LUBRICATION LOG — RECORD ALL POINTS SERVICED, GREASE GRADE, QUANTITY APPLIED AND TECHNICIAN INITIALS — FILE IN MAINTENANCE RECORDS

[PART C — POWERED OFF] FULLY DE-ENERGISE MACHINE — ISOLATE ALL ELECTRICAL SUPPLIES — APPLY FULL LOCKOUT/TAGOUT TO ALL ISOLATORS — VERIFY ZERO ENERGY WITH TEST METER — WARNING: DO NOT REACH INTO MACHINE
[PART C — POWERED OFF] CLEAN AND INSPECT ALL PE SENSOR LENSES IN PREFORM AND BOTTLE DETECTION ZONES — USE DRY LINT-FREE CLOTH — REPLACE ANY SENSOR WITH CRACKED OR SCRATCHED LENS
[PART C — POWERED OFF] CHECK PYROMETER LENSES AND MOUNTING BRACKETS IN HEATING OVEN — CLEAN LENSES WITH DRY COMPRESSED AIR — VERIFY BRACKETS ARE SECURE AND CORRECTLY ALIGNED
[PART C — POWERED OFF] REMOVE AND CLEAN ALL HEATING OVEN FILTER ELEMENTS — REPLACE FILTERS IF CLOGGED, TORN OR SHOWING REDUCED AIR FLOW — USE CORRECT FILTER SPECIFICATION ONLY
[PART C — POWERED OFF] INSPECT ALL INFRARED HEATING LAMPS IN EACH HEATING ZONE FOR DARK SPOTS, CRACKS OR REDUCED OUTPUT — REPLACE FAILED LAMPS — RECORD LAMP POSITIONS REPLACED
[PART C — POWERED OFF] DRAIN AND CLEAN CONDENSATE COLLECTION TRAYS AND DRAIN LINES — VERIFY ALL DRAIN VALVES OPEN AND CLOSE FREELY — FLUSH WITH CLEAN WATER
[PART C — POWERED OFF] REINSTATE MACHINE — REMOVE ALL LOTO DEVICES IN REVERSE ORDER — CLOSE ALL GUARDS — PERFORM E-STOP TEST BEFORE AUTHORISING RESTART — SIGN OFF IN MAINTENANCE LOG
STOP MACHINE — INITIATE CONTROLLED SHUTDOWN — PRESS E-STOP — APPLY FULL LOCKOUT/TAGOUT — DEPRESSURISE ALL PNEUMATIC CIRCUITS BY MANUALLY ACTUATING BLEED VALVES BEFORE BEGINNING WORK
INSPECT ALL PNEUMATIC CYLINDERS ON BLOWING STATIONS FOR SEAL INTEGRITY — LOOK FOR EXTERNAL LEAKAGE, OIL WEEPING OR SEAL EXTRUSION — REPLACE SEALS ON ANY CYLINDER SHOWING LEAKAGE
CHECK ROTARY JOINT SEALS, BEARINGS AND SLIP RINGS — VERIFY NO AIR LEAKAGE AT ROTARY INTERFACE — REPLACE SEALS IF LEAKAGE IS DETECTED — CONSULT KRONES IF BEARING PLAY IS PRESENT
INSPECT COMPLETE STRETCHING UNIT — CHECK DRIVE MECHANISM, GUIDE RAILS AND LINEAR BEARINGS FOR WEAR OR DAMAGE — MEASURE PLAY IN LINEAR BEARINGS — REPLACE WORN COMPONENTS
MEASURE NECK-RING GUIDE CLEARANCE ON ALL 12 BLOWING STATIONS USING FEELER GAUGES — RECORD MEASUREMENTS — ADJUST ANY STATION WHERE CLEARANCE EXCEEDS KRONES SPECIFICATION
APPLY SPECIFIED OIL TO ROTARY JOINT OIL PORTS AND ALL PIVOT POINTS ON STRETCHING UNIT ASSEMBLIES — USE KRONES SPECIFIED OIL GRADE — WIPE OFF EXCESS TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION
REINSTALL ALL GUARDS AND COVERS — REMOVE ALL LOTO DEVICES — PERFORM TEST RUN AT REDUCED SPEED — VERIFY BOTTLE QUALITY MEETS SPECIFICATION BEFORE RETURNING TO FULL PRODUCTION
SHUT DOWN MACHINE COMPLETELY — APPLY FULL LOCKOUT/TAGOUT TO ALL ENERGY SOURCES — ALLOW MACHINE TO COOL TO AMBIENT TEMPERATURE BEFORE WORKING ON FILTER SYSTEMS
REMOVE AND REPLACE ALL ACTIVATED CARBON FILTER ELEMENTS IN THE MOULD AREA AIR FILTRATION SYSTEM — DISPOSE OF USED FILTERS AS HAZARDOUS WASTE PER SITE WASTE PROCEDURE
TEST MAIN DRIVE MOTOR ELECTROMAGNETIC BRAKE FUNCTION — VERIFY HOLDING TORQUE MEETS KRONES SPECIFICATION — MEASURE BRAKE RELEASE/APPLY TIME — ADJUST IF OUT OF SPECIFICATION
DOCUMENT ALL FILTER PART NUMBERS AND QUANTITIES REPLACED — UPDATE FILTER CHANGE LOG AND MAINTENANCE HISTORY — REMOVE ALL LOTO DEVICES — SIGN OFF WITH TECHNICIAN AND SUPERVISOR
STOP MACHINE — ISOLATE MAIN ELECTRICAL SUPPLY — APPLY FULL LOCKOUT/TAGOUT TO MAIN ISOLATOR AND ALL LOCAL ISOLATORS — NOTIFY SITE ELECTRICAL ENGINEER BEFORE COMMENCING
CHECK ALL SERVO DRIVE UNITS FOR OIL LEAKAGE FROM GEARBOX SEALS — INSPECT AROUND SHAFT SEALS AND DRAIN PLUGS — RECORD ANY LEAKAGE — SCHEDULE REPAIR WITH KRONES IF LEAKAGE FOUND
CHECK ALL SERVO DRIVE COOLING FANS FOR CORRECT OPERATION, ABSENCE OF OBSTRUCTIONS AND NO UNUSUAL NOISE — CLEAN FAN GRILLES OF DUST ACCUMULATION
TEST RCD (RESIDUAL CURRENT DEVICE) CIRCUIT BREAKER — PRESS TEST BUTTON — VERIFY CIRCUIT TRIPS WITHIN SPECIFICATION TIME — RESET AND TEST AGAIN — RECORD RESULT IN ELECTRICAL MAINTENANCE LOG
DOCUMENT RCD TEST RESULT IN ELECTRICAL MAINTENANCE RECORD — SUBMIT TO SITE ELECTRICAL ENGINEER FOR REVIEW AND SIGN-OFF — REMOVE LOTO — REINSTATE MACHINE TO OPERATIONAL STATUS
ALL 6000HR TASKS REQUIRE KRONES-AUTHORISED SERVICE ENGINEER ATTENDANCE — ARRANGE KRONES SERVICE VISIT IN ADVANCE — DO NOT COMMENCE 6000HR WORK WITHOUT KRONES ENGINEER ON SITE
INSPECT ALL GUARD DOORS, HINGES, GAS STRUTS, INTERLOCKS AND SAFETY SWITCHES FOR WEAR, DAMAGE AND CORRECT FUNCTION — REPLACE ANY COMPONENT THAT DOES NOT MEET SAFETY STANDARD
INSPECT AND SERVICE ELECTRICAL CABINET AIR CONDITIONING UNIT — CLEAN FILTERS, CHECK REFRIGERANT LEVEL AND CONDENSER COILS — ARRANGE SPECIALIST SERVICE IF REFRIGERANT IS LOW
REPLACE ALL HIGH-PRESSURE BLOW AIR FILTER ELEMENTS — MAIN PARTICULATE FILTER AND COALESCENT FILTER — USE KRONES SPECIFIED PARTS ONLY — RECORD PART NUMBERS IN MAINTENANCE LOG
COMPLETE KRONES ANNUAL MACHINE INSPECTION — ALL ITEMS PER KRONES STANDARD INSPECTION CHECKLIST — KRONES ENGINEER TO DOCUMENT ALL FINDINGS AND CORRECTIVE ACTIONS REQUIRED
CHECK ALL PRESSURE VESSELS AND SAFETY RELIEF VALVES — VERIFY CERTIFICATION DATES ARE CURRENT — IF ANY CERTIFICATE HAS EXPIRED ARRANGE RECERTIFICATION BEFORE RETURNING MACHINE TO SERVICE
INSPECT ALL HYDRAULIC AND PNEUMATIC HOSE LINES THROUGHOUT MACHINE — CHECK FOR HARDENING, SURFACE CRACKING, CHAFING OR DAMAGE — REPLACE ALL AGED HOSES AS PREVENTIVE MEASURE
OBTAIN KRONES ENGINEER WRITTEN SIGN-OFF ON COMPLETED ANNUAL INSPECTION — SUBMIT COMPLETED REPORT TO MAINTENANCE MANAGER — FILE IN EQUIPMENT HISTORY — REMOVE ALL LOTO AND REINSTATE
CONFIRM LASER CODER SAFETY INTERLOCK IS ACTIVE AND FUME EXTRACTOR IS RUNNING BEFORE START OF SHIFT — VERIFY EXTRACTOR SUCTION IS PRESENT AT HOSE NOZZLE
VERIFY BOTTLE IS PRINTING CORRECT MESSAGE FORMAT: XXDDMMMYY HHMM — CHECK AGAINST CURRENT BATCH SPECIFICATION — REJECT ANY BOTTLE WITH INCORRECT OR MISSING CODE
VERIFY BEST BY DATE FORMAT IS CORRECT: DDMMMYYYY — COMPARE PRINTED DATE AGAINST CURRENT BATCH DOCUMENTATION — ESCALATE ANY DISCREPANCY TO SUPERVISOR IMMEDIATELY
VERIFY CORRECT PLANT LINE NUMBER IS BEING PRINTED ON EACH BOTTLE — CONFIRM LINE 3 FORMAT IS ACTIVE IN CODER SETTINGS — LOG CONFIRMATION IN SHIFT RECORD
LOG CODER READINGS AND CONFIRM PRINT QUALITY IS ACCEPTABLE — RECORD ANY DEVIATIONS, FADES OR REJECTED BOTTLES IN SHIFT LOG — REPORT PERSISTENT ISSUES TO MAINTENANCE
LOCK OUT AND TAG OUT THE LASER CODER MACHINE — APPLY LOTO DEVICE TO CODER MAIN POWER DISCONNECT — VERIFY MACHINE IS FULLY POWERED DOWN BEFORE PROCEEDING
RE-CHECK ALL EMERGENCY STOP SWITCHES AND CONTROLS ARE CORRECTLY POSITIONED, OPERATIONAL AND ACCESSIBLE — DOCUMENT E-STOP LOCATIONS IN PM RECORD
CHECK BOTTLE IS PRINTING CORRECT MESSAGE FORMAT: XXDDMMMYY HHMM — SAMPLE MINIMUM 5 CONSECUTIVE BOTTLES — COMPARE AGAINST CURRENT BATCH SPECIFICATION BEFORE POWERING DOWN FOR SERVICE
VERIFY CORRECT PLANT LINE NUMBER FORMAT IS PRINTED ON EACH BOTTLE — CONFIRM LINE NUMBER MATCHES PRODUCTION SCHEDULE — PHOTOGRAPH SAMPLE FOR RECORD
VERIFY BEST BY DATE FORMAT: DDMMMYYYY — COMPARE WITH CURRENT BATCH RECORDS AND PRODUCTION ORDER — ESCALATE ANY DISCREPANCY BEFORE PROCEEDING WITH PM
ENTER PASSWORD DLI ON CODER CONTROL PANEL TO ACCESS MAINTENANCE MODE — CONFIRM MAINTENANCE MODE IS ACTIVE ON DISPLAY BEFORE PROCEEDING
DISABLE HEAD A ON CODER CONTROL PANEL — NAVIGATE TO HEAD CONTROL MENU — SELECT HEAD A — SELECT DISABLE — CONFIRM HEAD A SHOWS DISABLED STATUS ON DISPLAY
TURN DC POWER KEY SWITCH TO THE OFF POSITION — REMOVE KEY AND RETAIN IN SAFE LOCATION — VERIFY CONTROL PANEL SCREEN HAS GONE DARK
DEPRESS RED POWER BUTTON TO FULLY POWER DOWN CODER ELECTRONICS — VERIFY ALL STATUS LIGHTS ON CONTROL PANEL ARE EXTINGUISHED
DEPRESS EMERGENCY STOP BUTTON AND VERIFY MACHINE IS COMPLETELY POWERED DOWN — APPLY LOTO HASP AND PERSONAL DANGER TAG — VERIFY ZERO ENERGY BEFORE OPENING ANY PANEL
INSPECT ALL EXTERNAL CODER CABLES FOR DAMAGE, FRAYING, CUTS OR SIGNS OF HEAT DAMAGE — PAY ATTENTION TO CABLE ENTRY POINTS AND AREAS SUBJECT TO MOVEMENT OR VIBRATION
OPEN REAR ACCESS DOOR — INSPECT ALL INTERNAL CABLE CONNECTIONS AND CIRCUIT BOARD CONNECTORS — VERIFY NONE ARE LOOSE, CORRODED OR DAMAGED — RESEAT ANY LOOSE CONNECTORS
CHECK AIR LINE SUPPLY TO LASER HEAD — VERIFY PRESSURE IS CORRECT AND WITHIN SPECIFICATION — CHECK LINE FOR MOISTURE, KINKS OR RESTRICTIONS — DRAIN AIR FILTER IF MOISTURE IS PRESENT
INSPECT LASER HEAD HOUSING FOR CRACKS, IMPACT DAMAGE OR SIGNS OF OVERHEATING — CHECK MOUNTING BRACKETS ARE SECURE — VERIFY LASER APERTURE WINDOW IS CLEAN AND UNDAMAGED
CLEAN EXTERIOR OF LASER CODER CABINET AND LASER HEAD HOUSING WITH LINT-FREE CLOTH — REMOVE ALL DUST, PRODUCT RESIDUE AND DEBRIS — DO NOT USE SOLVENT OR WATER ON ELECTRICAL COMPONENTS
LOCK OUT AND TAG OUT THE FUME EXTRACTOR SEPARATELY — APPLY LOTO DEVICE TO FUME EXTRACTOR MAIN POWER ISOLATOR — NOTE: LASER FUMES ARE HAZARDOUS — NEVER BYPASS FUME EXTRACTOR LOTO
CHECK FUME EXTRACTOR OPERATION SCREEN FOR ACTIVE FAULT CODES AND FILTER STATUS INDICATORS — RECORD ANY ACTIVE ALARMS IN PM RECORD BEFORE PROCEEDING WITH FILTER INSPECTION
CHECK VACUUM LEVEL AT EXTRACTION HOSE NOZZLE USING VACUUM GAUGE — VERIFY ADEQUATE SUCTION IS PRESENT — RECORD READING IN PM LOG — LOW SUCTION INDICATES FILTER BLOCKAGE
TURN OFF FUME EXTRACTOR (DPX) USING OPERATING SWITCH — WAIT FOR COMPLETE MOTOR AND FAN STOP (MINIMUM 2 MINUTES) BEFORE OPENING FILTER COMPARTMENT — NEVER OPEN UNDER POWER
CHECK BOX FILTER ELEMENTS — INSPECT FOR SATURATION, CLOGGING OR PHYSICAL DAMAGE — REPLACE FILTERS IF DIRTY, DAMAGED OR BEYOND SERVICE LIFE — DISPOSE PER HAZARDOUS WASTE PROCEDURE
CHECK BAG FILTER ELEMENTS — INSPECT FOR SATURATION, CLOGGING OR PHYSICAL DAMAGE — REPLACE FILTERS IF DIRTY, DAMAGED OR BEYOND SERVICE LIFE — DISPOSE PER HAZARDOUS WASTE PROCEDURE
CHECK VACUUM EXTRACTION HOSE FOR KINKS, CRACKS, HOLES OR LOOSE CONNECTIONS AT BOTH THE CODER HEAD END AND THE EXTRACTOR END — REPLACE HOSE IF DAMAGED
CHECK FUME EXTRACTOR CABINET HOUSING FOR DAMAGE, LOOSE PANELS, CORROSION OR SIGNS OF HEAT DAMAGE — VERIFY ALL VENTILATION OPENINGS ARE UNOBSTRUCTED
RESTORE FUME EXTRACTOR POWER — REMOVE ALL LOTO DEVICES FROM FUME EXTRACTOR ONLY — RESTART EXTRACTOR AND VERIFY NORMAL OPERATION BEFORE PROCEEDING TO RESTORE CODER POWER
REMOVE ALL LOTO DEVICES FROM LASER CODER — RESTORE MAIN POWER — REINSERT DC POWER KEY AND TURN TO ON POSITION — POWER UP CODER USING NORMAL START PROCEDURE
RE-CHECK ALL EMERGENCY STOP SWITCHES AND CONTROLS BEFORE RETURNING CODER TO SERVICE — VERIFY EVERY E-STOP IS FUNCTIONAL AND CLEARLY ACCESSIBLE — TEST E-STOP TRIP

FOLLOW ALL GMP PROCEDURES FOR RETURN TO SERVICE — VERIFY PRINT QUALITY MEETS SPECIFICATION ON FIRST 10 BOTTLES AFTER RESTART — CONFIRM CORRECT MESSAGE, DATE AND LINE NUMBER BEFORE AUTHORISING PRODUCTION
COMPLETE AND SIGN PM RECORD — RECORD ALL FILTER PART NUMBERS AND QUANTITIES USED IN PARTS LOG — SUPERVISOR TO COUNTERSIGN — FILE COMPLETED RECORD IN MAINTENANCE HISTORY
CONFIRM DEHUMIDIFIER IS RUNNING IN AUTOMATIC MODE — VERIFY FAN OVERRUN FUNCTION IS ACTIVE — NEVER SWITCH OFF USING MAIN SWITCH WHILE UNIT IS HOT
READ AND RECORD INLET DEW POINT TEMPERATURE FROM DISPLAY PANEL — VERIFY READING IS WITHIN ACCEPTABLE OPERATIONAL RANGE — LOG VALUE IN SHIFT RECORD
READ AND RECORD OUTLET DEW POINT TEMPERATURE FROM DISPLAY PANEL — VERIFY DRYING PERFORMANCE IS ADEQUATE — COMPARE TO PREVIOUS READINGS — ALERT MAINTENANCE IF DRYING PERFORMANCE HAS DROPPED
READ AND RECORD PROCESS AIR TEMPERATURE FROM DISPLAY PANEL — VERIFY TEMPERATURE IS WITHIN OPERATIONAL PARAMETERS — REPORT ANY READING OUTSIDE NORMAL RANGE

CHECK FILTER STATUS INDICATOR ON DISPLAY PANEL — VERIFY NO FILTER CHANGE ALARM IS ACTIVE — IF FILTER ALARM IS ACTIVE SCHEDULE FILTER CHANGE IMMEDIATELY — DO NOT RUN WITH DIRTY FILTERS (VOIDS WARRANTY)
LOG ALL DISPLAY READINGS IN SHIFT MAINTENANCE LOG — RECORD TIME OF CHECK, TECHNICIAN NAME AND ALL FOUR VALUES — REPORT ANY ALARMS OR DEVIATIONS TO MAINTENANCE SUPERVISOR
SHUT DOWN DEHUMIDIFIER USING OPERATING SWITCH ONLY — WAIT MINIMUM 3 MINUTES FOR FAN OVERRUN AND COOLING — THEN ISOLATE MAIN POWER — NEVER USE MAIN SWITCH TO STOP UNIT WHILE RUNNING
WAIT FOR COMPLETE COOLING OF ALL INTERNAL COMPONENTS — INTERNAL PARTS REACH OVER 64Â°C — WEAR HEAT-RESISTANT GLOVES AND SAFETY GLASSES BEFORE OPENING ANY PANEL OR TOUCHING INTERNAL PARTS
INSPECT ALL EXTERNAL FILTER HOUSINGS FOR PHYSICAL DAMAGE, CRACKS OR SIGNS OF BYPASS — VERIFY HOUSING SEALS ARE INTACT AND NO AIR IS BYPASSING THE FILTER MEDIA
REMOVE AND REPLACE MAIN PROCESS AIR FILTER ELEMENT — NOTE FILTER FLOW DIRECTION ARROW BEFORE REMOVAL — FIT NEW FILTER WITH ARROW IN CORRECT DIRECTION — DISPOSE OF OLD FILTER PER WASTE REGULATIONS
REMOVE AND REPLACE PRE-FILTER ELEMENT IN INLET AIR FILTER HOUSING — USE CORRECT SPECIFICATION AND GRADE ONLY — RUNNING WITH WRONG FILTER VOIDS WARRANTY — RECORD PART NUMBER USED
CHECK FILTER CHANGE COUNTER AND TIMER ON DISPLAY PANEL — RESET COUNTER AND TIMER AFTER FILTER REPLACEMENT IS COMPLETE — DOCUMENT RESET TIME IN SERVICE RECORD
INSPECT DRYING WHEEL AREA THROUGH INSPECTION PORT — CHECK FOR VISIBLE CONTAMINATION, DISCOLOURATION OR PHYSICAL DAMAGE — IF DAMAGE FOUND CONTACT EISBAR SERVICE — DO NOT ATTEMPT INTERNAL REPAIRS
CHECK ALL INTERNAL DUCT CONNECTIONS AND GASKETS IN FILTER COMPARTMENT FOR SECURE FIT AND NO BYPASS LEAKS — PRESS TEST ALL DUCT JOINTS FOR MOVEMENT — RESEAT ANY LOOSE DUCTS
INSPECT ELECTRICAL AIR HEATER AREA FOR SIGNS OF OVERHEATING, SEVERE DISCOLOURATION, BURN MARKS OR PHYSICAL DAMAGE — IF ANY DAMAGE IS FOUND CONTACT EISBAR SERVICE PERSONNEL IMMEDIATELY
REINSTATE DEHUMIDIFIER USING OPERATING SWITCH ONLY — DO NOT USE MAIN SWITCH TO START — ALLOW UNIT TO REACH FULL OPERATING CONDITION (MINIMUM 10 MINUTES) BEFORE RETURNING CONTIFORM TO PRODUCTION
VERIFY DISPLAY SHOWS NORMAL OPERATING VALUES — CHECK OUTLET DEW POINT IS WITHIN SPECIFICATION — LOG COMPLETED SERVICE IN MAINTENANCE RECORD — FILE FILTER PART NUMBERS AND QUANTITIES
CHECK ALL SAFETY GUARDS ARE CLOSED AND INTERLOCKED — VERIFY ALL E-STOP BUTTONS ARE ACCESSIBLE AND OPERATIONAL — REPORT ANY DEFEATED INTERLOCK OR MISSING GUARD IMMEDIATELY
VISUALLY INSPECT FILM WRAPPING MODULE FROM OUTSIDE GUARD — CHECK FOR JAMS, TORN FILM, MISALIGNED PACKS OR FILM TANGLED AROUND WRAPPING RODS — DO NOT OPEN GUARD WHILE RUNNING
CHECK FILM FEED FROM BOTH FILM MANDRELS — VERIFY CORRECT FILM TENSION AND NO FILM SNAKING, SKEWING OR SLIPPING ON MANDREL SPINDLES — REPORT ABNORMAL FILM FEED TO OPERATOR
CHECK BOTTLE INFEED CONVEYOR AND CONTAINER SPACER FOR BLOCKAGES, MISFED BOTTLES OR DAMAGED SPACER LUGS — CLEAR BLOCKAGES USING APPROVED TOOLS ONLY — NEVER REACH INSIDE WHILE RUNNING
CHECK PUSHER CHAIN DRIVE OPERATION FROM OUTSIDE GUARD — LISTEN FOR UNUSUAL RATTLING, KNOCKING OR SQUEALING — REPORT ANY ABNORMAL NOISE TO MAINTENANCE — DO NOT OPEN GUARD WHILE RUNNING
VERIFY FILM CUTTING STATION IS CUTTING CLEANLY — INSPECT OUTPUT PACKS FOR TORN EDGES, MISSED CUTS, LONG TAILS OR UNSEALED ENDS — REPORT POOR CUT QUALITY TO MAINTENANCE
CHECK GLUE UNIT TEMPERATURE ON HMI DISPLAY — VERIFY TEMPERATURE IS WITHIN OPERATING RANGE — CHECK ADHESIVE IS DISPENSING CORRECTLY AND NO STRINGING OR OVER-APPLICATION IS VISIBLE
CHECK WRAPPED PACKS EXITING MACHINE FOR CORRECT APPEARANCE, TIGHT FILM WRAP, CLEAN SEALED SEAMS AND CORRECT BOTTLE COUNT PER PACK — REJECT ANY UNDER-WRAPPED OR DAMAGED PACKS
LOG MACHINE HOUR COUNTER READING — RECORD ANY DEVIATIONS, FAULT CODES, FILM BREAKS OR JAMS IN SHIFT LOG — NOTE ANY ITEMS REQUIRING FOLLOW-UP MAINTENANCE
STOP MACHINE — INITIATE CONTROLLED SHUTDOWN — PRESS E-STOP — ISOLATE MAIN ELECTRICAL SUPPLY — APPLY FULL LOCKOUT/TAGOUT TO ALL ISOLATORS — DEPRESSURISE PNEUMATIC CIRCUITS
INSPECT FILM WRAPPING ORBITING RODS FOR BENDING, WEAR OR EXCESSIVE PLAY IN BEARINGS — MANUALLY OPERATE THROUGH FULL ROTATION — CHECK ORBITAL MOTION IS SMOOTH AND CORRECT
CHECK FILM MANDREL 1 SPINDLE BEARINGS FOR WEAR OR PLAY — MANUALLY ROTATE AND FEEL FOR ROUGHNESS, BINDING OR UNEVEN RESISTANCE — REPLACE BEARING IF WORN
CHECK FILM MANDREL 2 SPINDLE BEARINGS FOR WEAR OR PLAY — MANUALLY ROTATE AND FEEL FOR ROUGHNESS, BINDING OR UNEVEN RESISTANCE — REPLACE BEARING IF WORN
CLEAN FILM SPLICING UNIT THOROUGHLY — REMOVE ALL ADHESIVE TAPE RESIDUE, FILM STRIPS AND DUST FROM SPLICE TABLE SURFACE — USE APPROVED SOLVENT AND LINT-FREE CLOTH
CHECK FILM TENSIONING DEVICE — VERIFY SPRING TENSION IS CORRECT AND HAS NOT RELAXED — VERIFY ALL TENSION ROLLERS ROTATE FREELY WITHOUT BINDING — ADJUST TENSION IF OUTSIDE SPECIFICATION
CLEAN FILM CUTTING BLADE STATION — REMOVE ALL FILM SCRAPS AND DEBRIS — INSPECT BLADE EDGE FOR SHARPNESS AND CHIPS — WEAR CUT-RESISTANT GLOVES — REPLACE BLADE IF EDGE IS DULL OR NICKED
CLEAN ALL CONTAINER SPACER LUGS — REMOVE PRODUCT RESIDUE AND FILM DEBRIS — CHECK SPACER LUGS FOR CRACKS OR WEAR — REPLACE ANY DAMAGED LUGS BEFORE RETURNING TO SERVICE
INSPECT PUSHER CHAIN TENSION AND CONDITION — CHECK CHAIN IS NOT OVER-STRETCHED — INSPECT ALL CHAIN LINKS AND ATTACHMENT PLATES FOR WEAR, CRACKS OR DEFORMATION — ADJUST TENSION IF REQUIRED
APPLY SPECIFIED KRONES CHAIN LUBRICANT TO PUSHER CHAIN PER LUBRICATION SCHEDULE — APPLY TO INNER CHAIN LINKS — WIPE OFF EXCESS — RECORD LUBRICANT TYPE AND QUANTITY IN LUBE LOG
CAUTION: COMPENSATING CONVEYOR CONTINUES OPERATING SLOWLY IN SET-UP MODE — KEEP HANDS CLEAR OF CONVEYOR AT ALL TIMES — VERIFY CONVEYOR BELT CONDITION AND TRACKING FROM OUTSIDE GUARD
REMOVE ALL LOTO DEVICES — REINSTATE MACHINE — PERFORM E-STOP TEST — RUN MACHINE WITH SAMPLE PACKS — VERIFY PACKING QUALITY AND FILM WRAP BEFORE RETURNING TO FULL PRODUCTION
STOP MACHINE — APPLY FULL LOCKOUT/TAGOUT — SERVO MOTORS REACH 90Â°C AND ARE A BURN HAZARD — ALLOW MINIMUM 30 MINUTES COOLING TIME BEFORE TOUCHING ANY SERVO MOTOR HOUSING
CLEAN ALL SERVO MOTOR HOUSINGS WITH LOW-PRESSURE COMPRESSED AIR — REMOVE DUST AND FILM FIBRE ACCUMULATION FROM COOLING FINS — WARNING: MOTORS REACH 90Â°C — DO NOT TOUCH UNTIL CONFIRMED COOL
INSPECT ALL SERVO MOTOR CABLE ENTRIES, GLAND SEALS AND CONNECTORS FOR WEAR, DAMAGE OR MOISTURE INGRESS — VERIFY GLAND SEALS ARE INTACT AND CABLES ARE NOT CHAFING ON SHARP EDGES
CHECK PNEUMATIC VALVE ISLAND MANIFOLD — VERIFY ALL SOLENOID VALVES CYCLE CORRECTLY USING MANUAL OVERRIDE TEST — CHECK MANIFOLD AND ALL FITTINGS FOR AIR LEAKS — REPAIR LEAKS FOUND
CHECK GLUE UNIT HOSES AND NOZZLES FOR BLOCKAGE, LEAKAGE OR CHARRING — CAUTION: HOT LIQUID GLUE HAZARD — WEAR HEAT-RESISTANT GLOVES AND FACE SHIELD WHEN WORKING NEAR GLUE UNIT
GREASE ALL FILM WRAPPING MODULE BEARINGS, PIVOT POINTS AND CAM FOLLOWERS PER KRONES LUBRICATION MAP — USE SPECIFIED GREASE GRADE — RECORD ALL POINTS SERVICED IN LUBE LOG
CHECK FILM CUTTING BLADE CONDITION — INSPECT EDGE FOR NICKS, DULLING OR BLADE DAMAGE — REPLACE BLADE IF CUT QUALITY HAS DETERIORATED — WEAR CUT-RESISTANT GLOVES WHEN HANDLING BLADE
CHECK FILM SPLICING UNIT DRIVE BELT CONDITION AND TENSION — VERIFY BELT IS NOT CRACKED, GLAZED OR STRETCHED BEYOND LIMITS — REPLACE BELT IF WORN
REINSTATE MACHINE — REMOVE ALL LOTO — PERFORM E-STOP TEST — RUN COMPLETE WRAPPING CYCLE WITH SAMPLE PACKS — VERIFY ALL FUNCTIONS BEFORE RETURNING TO FULL PRODUCTION
STOP MACHINE — APPLY FULL LOCKOUT/TAGOUT TO ALL ENERGY ISOLATORS — FULLY DE-ENERGISE ALL PNEUMATIC CIRCUITS — ALLOW MACHINE TO COOL BEFORE COMMENCING WORK
REPLACE FILM FEED BELT ON BOTH FILM MANDREL ASSEMBLIES — RECORD OLD BELT CONDITION AND PART NUMBER — INSTALL NEW BELTS — VERIFY CORRECT TENSION AND ALIGNMENT AFTER REPLACEMENT
REPLENISH GREASE IN ALL MAIN DRIVE GEARBOX OIL/GREASE FILL POINTS — USE KRONES SPECIFIED GREASE GRADE ONLY — DO NOT OVER-FILL — RECORD QUANTITIES IN LUBRICATION LOG
INSPECT MAIN DRIVE CHAIN COMPLETE LENGTH — MEASURE CHAIN ELONGATION USING CHAIN WEAR GAUGE — REPLACE CHAIN IF STRETCH EXCEEDS MANUFACTURER WEAR LIMIT — RECORD MEASUREMENT
REINSTATE MACHINE — REMOVE ALL LOTO — PERFORM EXTENDED TEST RUN OF MINIMUM 30 MINUTES — VERIFY ALL FUNCTIONS CORRECT — SUBMIT COMPLETED SERVICE RECORD TO MAINTENANCE MANAGER
STOP MACHINE — APPLY FULL LOCKOUT/TAGOUT — CONTACT KRONES SERVICE DEPARTMENT BEFORE COMMENCING 3000HR SERVICE — ALL GEARBOX WORK REQUIRES KRONES APPROVED PROCEDURE
INSPECT ALL SERVO MOTOR GEARBOXES FOR OIL LEAKAGE FROM SEALS — CHECK OIL LEVEL IN EACH GEARBOX — TOP UP WITH KRONES SPECIFIED OIL GRADE IF LEVEL IS LOW — DO NOT MIX OIL GRADES
REPLACE MAIN DRIVE GEARBOX OIL — DRAIN COMPLETELY — FLUSH WITH KRONES FLUSHING OIL — REFILL WITH SPECIFIED KRONES GEARBOX OIL TO CORRECT LEVEL — DISPOSE OF WASTE OIL PER SITE PROCEDURE
CHECK ALL MAIN BEARINGS IN FILM WRAPPING MODULE — MANUALLY OPERATE AND LISTEN AND FEEL FOR ROUGHNESS, NOISE OR PLAY — REPLACE ANY BEARING SHOWING WEAR — DOCUMENT BEARINGS REPLACED
INSPECT ALL PNEUMATIC CYLINDER SEALS THROUGHOUT MACHINE — CHECK FOR EXTERNAL LEAKAGE, CONTAMINATION OR EXTRUSION — REPLACE COMPLETE SEAL KITS ON ANY CYLINDER SHOWING LEAKAGE
SUBMIT COMPLETED 3000HR SERVICE REPORT TO MAINTENANCE MANAGER — OBTAIN KRONES SERVICE ENGINEER SIGN-OFF — UPDATE MACHINE SERVICE HISTORY — REMOVE LOTO AND REINSTATE
ALL 6000HR ITEMS REQUIRE KRONES AUTHORISED SERVICE ENGINEER ATTENDANCE — ARRANGE KRONES ANNUAL INSPECTION VISIT IN ADVANCE — DO NOT COMMENCE WITHOUT KRONES ENGINEER ON SITE
COMPLETE KRONES ANNUAL INSPECTION OF ALL MECHANICAL, ELECTRICAL AND SAFETY SYSTEMS — ALL ITEMS PER KRONES 6000HR STANDARD INSPECTION CHECKLIST — KRONES ENGINEER TO SIGN OFF EACH ITEM
PRESSURE TEST ALL PNEUMATIC CIRCUITS THROUGHOUT MACHINE — VERIFY NO LEAKAGE AT RATED PRESSURE — INSPECT AND REPLACE ALL AGED OR DETERIORATED HOSE LINES AS PREVENTIVE MEASURE
OBTAIN KRONES ANNUAL INSPECTION CERTIFICATE — FILE CERTIFICATE AND COMPLETED CHECKLIST WITH SITE MAINTENANCE RECORDS AND EQUIPMENT HISTORY FILE — REMOVE LOTO AND REINSTATE MACHINE
VERIFY ALL SAFETY GUARDS AND HEAT SHIELDS IN PLACE - CHECK E-STOP BUTTONS ACCESSIBLE AND FUNCTIONAL
VISUALLY CHECK TUNNEL INTERIOR FOR DEBRIS OR FILM RESIDUE - CLEAR BLOCKAGES BEFORE PRODUCTION START
CHECK CONVEYOR BELT TENSION AND ALIGNMENT - ENSURE BELT RUNS CENTRALLY - ADJUST TRACKING SCREWS IF REQUIRED
VERIFY TUNNEL TEMPERATURE SETPOINTS WITHIN SPEC - UPPER AND LOWER ZONES REACH TARGET WITHIN 15 MINUTES OF STARTUP
CHECK ALL CIRCULATION FANS RUNNING - LISTEN FOR UNUSUAL BEARING NOISE - VERIFY UNIFORM AIR FLOW ACROSS TUNNEL WIDTH
CHECK COOLING WATER FLOW AND SPRAY NOZZLES UNBLOCKED - VERIFY DRAIN IS CLEAR - WATER TEMPERATURE BELOW 25C
WIPE DOWN EXTERIOR SURFACES AND INSPECTION WINDOWS - REMOVE FILM TRIM AND SHRINK DEBRIS FROM ENTRY AND EXIT ZONES
APPLY FULL LOTO - ISOLATE ELECTRICAL SUPPLY AND COMPRESSED AIR - VERIFY ZERO ENERGY STATE BEFORE PROCEEDING
INSPECT HEATING ELEMENTS FOR DAMAGE OR CORROSION - MEASURE RESISTANCE - REPLACE ANY ELEMENT OUTSIDE TOLERANCE
REPLACE TUNNEL FAN FILTERS - CLEAN FAN BLADES WITH COMPRESSED AIR - INSPECT MOTOR BEARINGS FOR WEAR
LUBRICATE CONVEYOR DRIVE CHAIN WITH HEAT-RESISTANT CHAIN OIL - LUBRICATE ALL ROLLER BEARINGS - CHECK CHAIN TENSION
CLEAN COOLING WATER SPRAY NOZZLES - DESCALE WITH CITRIC ACID IF REQUIRED - REPLACE WORN NOZZLE INSERTS
INSPECT ELECTRICAL CONNECTIONS IN CONTROL CABINET - TIGHTEN LOOSE TERMINALS - CHECK CABLE INSULATION FOR HEAT DAMAGE
APPLY FULL LOTO AND ALLOW TUNNEL TO COOL TO AMBIENT - MINIMUM 2-HOUR COOLDOWN AFTER LAST OPERATION
REPLACE CONVEYOR BELT IF WEAR EXCEEDS 10 PERCENT - REPLACE ALL ROLLER BEARINGS AS PREVENTIVE MEASURE
REPLACE ALL HEATING ELEMENT GASKETS AND SEALS - INSPECT AND RE-INSULATE TUNNEL WALLS IF HEAT LOSS EXCEEDS SPEC
OVERHAUL MAIN DRIVE GEARBOX - DRAIN AND REPLACE GEAR OIL - INSPECT GEARS AND BEARINGS - REPLACE AS REQUIRED
